zdania.en: Grab the handles and brace your core.

zrodla.cytat: Seat height mid-hip, hands on handles, core braced.
Keep the torso braced.

zdania.pl: Pchaj i ciągnij uchwyty, a jednocześnie mocno pedałuj.
zdania.en: Push and pull the handles while you pedal hard.

zrodla.cytat: Push and pull handles while pedalling powerfully.
The push-pull handles engage the shoulders, chest, back, and arms while the pedals drive the legs and hips.
Slouching → sit tall.
Poor posture reduces power output and increases fatigue.

zdania.en: Working only with your arms and not your legs.

zrodla.cytat: Arm-only → engage legs.
Drive with the legs first.

zdania.pl: Połóż się na plecach z ugiętymi nogami.
zdania.en: Lie on your back with your knees bent.

zrodla.cytat: Lie on your back with your left knee bent and drawn up toward your chest.
Lie on your back, with your knees bent as if you were going to perform a sit-up or oblique crunch.

zdania.pl: Przyciągaj łokieć do przeciwnego kolana ze skrętem tułowia, potem zmień strony, prostując drugą nogę.
zdania.en: Bring your elbow toward the opposite knee with a twist, then switch sides as the other leg straightens.

zrodla.cytat: lift your right shoulder off the floor and move your right elbow toward your left knee.
As you bend your knee towards you, raise your opposite elbow towards your knee in a twisting motion.

zdania.en: Pulling on your head with your hands.

zrodla.cytat: You shouldn't pull on your neck or your head at any point during the bicycle crunch

rozpocznij powolne, kontrolowane opuszczanie ciała bez utraty wyprostowanej sylwetki.

Roll the underside of each foot

the barbell is first pressed in front of the head, then lowered behind the neck and finally pressed
